description: A nullable decimal parameter, a *apd.Decimal, binds NULL when nil and the decimal otherwise, as a decimal held by value binds, in every position through the DuckDB driver: an INSERT, a batch, a copyfrom, an UPDATE's SET, a comparison, optional filters, a runtime builder's own parameter and COALESCE's fallback; a slice of decimals and a runtime builder's Where value bind, and nullable decimals read back as NULL or their value.
